summary: Frontend-only Intervia SaaS tested comprehensively via Playwright on the public preview URL. 58/58 critical checks passed covering: Landing (hero, product-preview, how-it-works 1-4, report card, CTAs), Auth (login success/empty-error/forgot-password dialog, /app auth-required-state when logged out), Signup chooser + /signup/individual validation (3 errors shown), App shell (sidebar nav, context switcher, global search Ctrl+K + typing 'Sarah', notifications, profile menu, stats), Interviews list/detail (search, filters, item click iv_1041, tabs overview/skills/transcript/report/recording, transcript-jump opens video-modal, recording open-video-modal, open-resume-modal, pending iv_1045 shows not-ready-pending), New interview (skills-input add via Enter), Candidates (search, sort-by-score), Workspaces/Members/Invitations/Settings pages load, Role switching via role-switcher-select (VIEWER hides members, /app/members shows restricted-state; ADMIN restores), Invitations duplicate email j.park@northwindlabs.io shows invite-error, Simulate error -> error-state, Simulate empty renders, Mobile 390px shows mobile-menu-button on /app/interviews. No page errors, no backend 500s (frontend-only mock layer).

issues: Recharts logs width(-1)/height(-1) warnings on initial mount when container has 0 size — not visible to user but adds console noise. Consider setting minHeight on ResponsiveContainer wrapper.

design_issues.screen: Dialogs (forgot password, command palette, invite modal)
issues: Radix DialogContent missing Description/aria-describedby — accessibility warning. Add <DialogDescription> or aria-describedby to silence and improve a11y.

action_items: (Optional) Fix Recharts ResponsiveContainer 0-size warnings on Overview page by setting a minHeight on the chart container.
(Optional) Add DialogDescription/aria-describedby to all DialogContent components (forgot-password dialog, command palette, invite dialog) for a11y.
critical_code_review_comments: Overall code quality looks good; routes well-structured in App.js. SessionProvider wraps correctly. No critical issues observed during runtime.
Minor: Recharts chart containers should enforce minHeight to prevent SSR/initial-render size warnings.
Minor: All Radix dialogs should include DialogDescription for a11y compliance.
test_credentials: demo login accepts prefilled hannah.reyes@northwindlabs.io / demo-password (any non-empty works)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All data-testids from the spec are present and wired. Session key: localStorage['intervia.session.v1']. Mock latency ~450ms — add 600-1000ms waits after navigations. Role switcher is visible at >=1280 width; use 1920 viewport for ADMIN/HR/VIEWER toggling. ?simulate=error/empty query params on /app/* work. Mobile 390px shows list-only on /app/interviews with mobile-menu-button.
